# Gerardo Luna Ventura

> QA Engineer and AI-Powered Test Automation specialist based in Mexico City, with 7+ years of experience in financial and insurance software testing.

Gerardo works across functional, regression, integration, acceptance, mobile, performance, and automated testing. His experience includes Aplazo, MTP International, and Accenture. His skills include Selenium WebDriver, Playwright, Appium, Postman, Bruno, C#, AWS, and AI-assisted QA.
